images.prompt: A worn wooden desk at night lit by one low desk lamp, a closed notebook lying shut on it, and several overlapping pale rings left by cups in the wood grain. No writing anywhere, the notebook cover plain and unmarked. Cream lamplight, deep shadow beyond. The single red element is one small charger indicator light. Deep dark navy dominates every surface and every background plane — never blue, never cyan, no teal anywhere. Soft cream (#F4EFE3) is the only highlight. Exactly one red element in the entire image, nothing else is red. Absolutely no text, no letterforms, no numerals, no signage, no logos, no vendor marks on any faceplate or panel. No tick-mark numerals. Full-bleed edge-to-edge artwork: no border, no cream margin, no white matting, no picture frame. Quiet, photographic, shallow depth of field.
images.qa: Approved, first roll. Worn desk, closed unmarked notebook, overlapping cup rings — accumulated nights rather than notes. Single charger LED.
